body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects corrective PR #1199, exact merge `dd096da1b7a8c28f4f824d178a16e59ecdc2ac7e`, head `eb50d6099ce51bc307becd073cb8d69524786f50`. Producing #1194 is closed with its canonical claim released (accepted inactive receipt 6023211772). Preserve its correctly added summary-workbook guard and exclusive output protection; do not reopen it or erase the original #1032 audit.

`croatia-batch4-reproduction-419-erratum/reproduce.py` checks 62 historical Git object pins and its own new scope/snapshot. It then imports the original `regional-review-ce7798317652c0c2/build_assessment.py` from the checkout. That builder consumes the current original `scope.json` and `source/issue-419-api-snapshot.json` using `read_text`; the new preflight never compares these consumed filesystem bytes to the pinned Git versions. Checking an immutable Git copy does not authenticate a different file subsequently read by the builder. The imported original code is likewise loaded from the checkout rather than the verified blob.

Executed failure trigger in an isolated detached review slot: construct two complete in-memory read-boundary fixtures for those original scope and issue snapshot files. Change only the first scoped province's `name` to `AUDITOR_SYNTHETIC_PARENT_LABEL`, and replace the embedded scope JSON in the matching old issue snapshot with that same coherent scope. Keep all 224 IDs, every source, workbook, new wrapper scope/snapshot, code and immutable Git object unchanged. The original builder sees only these two complete fixtures; no retained files are modified. The new wrapper's `run(...)` succeeds after preflight and publishes the synthetic label in all three report products.

Scope fixture: 13,960 bytes SHA-256 `848b95c5f78d70dc7fd001ed7ba62746f603372af047d299903296c8d91d42c4`. Old issue-snapshot fixture: 27,506 bytes SHA-256 `ca6669094027e37d3b04247d9ac3741444dc78a1cf137cfe2fa830ed119f8a02`. Accepted altered report hashes: summary `90f1c3aa570846abfd825482cd4f1d6d93eeace07031ec978f6e0c96179acd4f`, province CSV `a1439b0fb6376b6ca80f137a404778464bec3b4a0f6eb36f458cffaa431e575c`, subject CSV `151616355cde62aa93a683e36db868789d9f00edd70553172e1f5cc27a61ce25`. Numeric metric values stay unchanged, so a numerical-only check misses the altered context.

Positive checks: two original wrapper runs reproduce all three retained historical reports exactly. The retained reconstructed whole workbook (SHA `a479c0bf26d6da7eeb4241b967e296ea4fbb762b977cb4ef9db1c9cb70c44393`) is correctly rejected by the new summary guard before any destination is created. An existing destination sentinel is preserved. All 37 added files match head/merge bytes, all 62 baseline descriptors and 36 outputs match actual whole bytes/hashes, and baseline inputs remain unchanged. Full summary ZIP-member CRC/reads total 242,002 bytes. Actual inputs and decoded members stay within the 32 MiB ordinary/decoded, 256 MiB complete-phase and 512-descriptor limits. Private full fixtures, outputs and control code are retained.

Reproduction: load the exact merged wrapper and unchanged original builder. Supply the two complete fixtures only at the original builder's `Path.read_text` boundaries, using the paths above; execute the original wrapper into a fresh private destination under its evidence prefix. Assert all preflight checks pass, all original files remain unchanged, and `province_completeness[0].atlas_province_name` equals the synthetic label. This does not show wrong original parent labels; it demonstrates accepted drift in declared immutable reproduction inputs.

Expected and success: an additive new guarded runner authenticates the actual complete bytes of every scope/request/code file it consumes, including original scope and issue snapshot, before computation/output. Either consume verified immutable blobs directly or enforce the known immutable whole-file hashes at the actual read boundaries. Verify imported original/new runner code against a recorded immutable authority rather than only hashing an unused Git copy. Reject this coherent two-file fixture and individual scope/request/code drift before creating output; retain a matching genuine positive run, exact 224 subject/source associations, deterministic historical report comparisons and existing/interrupted-output preservation controls. Pin all inputs, bind generated controls/results, and obtain substantive distinct exact-head implementation/source review.

One-PR additive geography evidence correction, exclusively `data/regional-review/croatia-batch4-read-boundary-guard/`. Preserve every original packet, source, code, dated report and ID. The read-only input files and exact 224 subjects are declared below. No modifications to original/new prior packets, shared helpers, hierarchy, geography, imports or publication. No expansion into unavailable legal/census boundary restoration.

Readiness: complete open/closed issue pagination (13 pages; 1,208 entries including PRs), open PR pagination (one PR), and released #1194 ownership found no duplicate or owner of this new prefix. #1195 is the different batch-3 role/provenance task; #1028/#1029 are separate boundary/roster/name scope. Closed #1194 fixed its original workbook/overwrite defects, while this newly verified actual-consumption gap remains. Dependency #1194 is closed. Ready for one bounded additive PR; no implementation reservation taken; recheck overlap at claim time.

Limits: official DZS/DGU/legal page interpretations, census-date boundaries, reuse lineage, county parents, seven roster gaps and four name candidates remain separate unverified/unresolved scope. An accepted synthetic metadata input is not proof of wrong original geography. No geography approval, deployment, import, issue closure or publisher acceptance follows.
